_comment: Prevent Damage (2026-09-27, phase I1). The END-OF-MAIN PAIN SWEEP plus the whole damage-event
chain. Board: Tamanoa, Rhox Faithmender, Vito (all summoning sick -- mid-turn fixture resumed at
main 1, so nothing attacks), two untapped Battlefield Forges, empty hand. Nothing to cast, so
the only thing that can happen is TapPainSourcesIfUseful tapping each Forge in its COLOURED
mode (PreventDamageProvider::SelfDamageUseful: Tamanoa is out): each tap is ONE 1-damage event
from a noncreature source we control -> one Tamanoa trigger for 1 -> Faithmender doubles it to
2 -> Vito drains 2. So: us 20 -1 +2 -1 +2 = 22, opponent 20 -2 -2 = 16. A painless {C} sweep
would read 20/20; an un-doubled gain 20/18; a single aggregated event would still read 22/16
(Vito is affine), which is why the Dina fixture pins the event COUNT separately.
